# Solana Pulse AI Agent Gateway

Solana blockchain API and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. The gateway provides read-only lookups, transaction simulation, token metadata, priority-fee estimates, and transaction decoding on Solana mainnet-beta or devnet.

## Pricing
- Paid calls cost 0.0022 SOL (one credit) each.
- Each visitor gets 27 free calls tracked by a first-party cookie. Trial calls are shared between HTTP and MCP and do not require wallet sign-in.
- Command-line and Streamable HTTP clients should retain the returned `pulse_trial` cookie (for example, cURL `-b visitor-cookies.txt -c visitor-cookies.txt`) to keep the same visitor quota.
- After the trial, every API and MCP data call costs one credit per successful call. Operational routes such as authentication, credit lookup, and usage status do not consume a call credit.
- Requests are rate-limited to 120 per minute per IP.

## HTTP API
- `GET /api/solana/balance?wallet=<address>` — native SOL balance.
- `GET /api/solana/blockhash` — latest finalized blockhash.
- `GET /api/solana/token-accounts?wallet=<address>` — SPL token accounts.
- `GET /api/solana/transactions?wallet=<address>` — recent transaction signatures (maximum 50).
- `GET /api/solana/find-ata?wallet=<address>&mint=<mint>` — derive an ATA and check whether it exists.
- `POST /api/solana/simulate` — simulate a base64 serialized VersionedTransaction without broadcasting.
- `POST /api/solana/validate-and-simulate` — check and simulate a transaction, with a safety verdict and fix hints.
- `GET /api/solana/token-profile?mint=<mint>` — mint authorities, token details, risk signal, and top holders.
- `GET /api/solana/optimal-fee` — recent priority-fee estimates.
- `GET /api/solana/decode-tx?signature=<signature>` — transaction summary and balance changes.
- `GET /api/trial/status` — remaining calls for this visitor's first-party cookie.

## MCP Tools (20)
- Streamable HTTP endpoint: `POST /mcp`.
- SSE endpoint: `/mcp/sse` (messages at `/mcp/messages`).
- Tool manifest: `/.well-known/mcp.json`.
- Core tools: `get_solana_balance`, `get_solana_blockhash`, `get_token_accounts`, `get_recent_transactions`, `simulate_solana_transaction`, `find_ata`, `token_profile`, `optimal_fee`, `decode_tx`, and `validate_transaction`.
- Intelligence tools: `get_wallet_snapshot`, `summarize_wallet_activity`, `resolve_token_symbol`, `get_token_market_snapshot`, `analyze_token_concentration`, `compare_tokens`, `inspect_address`, `explain_transaction_effects`, `analyze_wallet_portfolio`, and `estimate_transaction_cost`.
- Each tool uses the visitor's shared 27-call trial allowance, then costs one credit per successful call.

## Authentication and credits
Paid requests require an API key in the `x-api-key` header. Obtain a key by signing in with a Solana wallet at `/api/auth/challenge` and `/api/auth/login`. Top up by sending SOL to the deposit address returned from `/api/claim/deposit-info`.
